\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{معقول} (māqūl)}{معقول (māqūl)}]{\ur{معقول} (māqūl) — reasonable}

\label{lesson:UR-C354-maqul}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for to hold up, then the Urdu for to win acceptance for.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{معقول}}
\textbf{\ur{معقول}} — \emph{māqūl} — \textquotedblleft{}reasonable\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{یہ} \ur{قیمت} \ur{معقول} \ur{ہے۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{yih qīmat māqūl hai.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
This price is reasonable.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{معقول}} (\emph{māqūl}) is usually traced, through Persian, to Arabic \emph{maʿqūl}, \textquotedblleft{}understood; rational\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for giving reasons and opinions.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{māqūl}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{māqūl}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{yih qīmat māqūl hai.} — This price is reasonable.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Urdu for to hold up, then the Urdu for to win acceptance for, then say \emph{māqūl} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{بے} \ur{جا} (be-jā)}{بے جا (be-jā)}]{\ur{بے} \ur{جا} (be-jā) — unwarranted; out of place}

\label{lesson:UR-C354-be-ja}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for legitimate, then the Urdu for a groundless fear.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{بے} \ur{جا}}
\textbf{\ur{بے} \ur{جا}} — \emph{be-jā} — \textquotedblleft{}unwarranted; out of place\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{آپ} \ur{کی} \ur{شکایت} \ur{بے} \ur{جا} \ur{ہے۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{āp kī shikāyat be-jā hai.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{بے} \ur{جا}} (\emph{be-jā}) is usually traced to Persian \emph{bē-jā}, \textquotedblleft{}out of place\textquotedblright{}: \emph{bē}, \textquotedblleft{}without\textquotedblright{}, and \emph{jā}, \textquotedblleft{}a place\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

One more word for giving reasons and opinions.

\section[(dialogue)]{Looking back: from The Issue at Hand to Reasonable or Not}

\label{lesson:UR-R354-review-347-354}



\begin{quote}
Say the Urdu for a matter to be settled and a compromise.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a matter to be settled, a compromise, a dispute, to get tangled, to bring up a topic
  \item an objection, criticism, a viewpoint, to threaten, to coax
  \item research, an experiment, a researcher, a discovery, to search out
  \item an average, figures, an analysis, a rate, to bring out
  \item a study, according to, a sample, to compare, to assess
  \item an article, a thesis, an intellectual, knowledge, to pick out
  \item a theory, an exception, real, to hold up, to win acceptance for
  \item reasonable, due, legitimate, a groundless fear, unwarranted
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A matter to be settled? (\textbf{\ur{معاملہ}}, \emph{muāmalā}.) A compromise? (\textbf{\ur{سمجھوتا}}, \emph{samjhautā}.) A dispute? (\textbf{\ur{تنازعہ}}, \emph{tanāzā}.) To get tangled? (\textbf{\ur{الجھنا}}, \emph{ulajhnā}.) To bring up a topic? (\textbf{\ur{چھیڑنا}}, \emph{chheṛnā}.) An objection? (\textbf{\ur{اعتراض}}, \emph{etirāz}.) Criticism? (\textbf{\ur{تنقید}}, \emph{tanqīd}.) A viewpoint? (\textbf{\ur{نقطہ} \ur{نظر}}, \emph{nuqta-e-nazar}.) To threaten? (\textbf{\ur{دھمکانا}}, \emph{dhamkānā}.) To coax? (\textbf{\ur{پھسلانا}}, \emph{phuslānā}.) Research? (\textbf{\ur{تحقیق}}, \emph{tahqīq}.) An experiment? (\textbf{\ur{تجربہ}}, \emph{tajribā}.) A researcher? (\textbf{\ur{محقق}}, \emph{muhaqqiq}.) A discovery? (\textbf{\ur{دریافت}}, \emph{daryāft}.) To search out? (\textbf{\ur{کھوجنا}}, \emph{khojnā}.) An average? (\textbf{\ur{اوسط}}, \emph{ausat}.) Figures? (\textbf{\ur{اعداد}}, \emph{adād}.) An analysis? (\textbf{\ur{تجزیہ}}, \emph{tajziyā}.) A rate? (\textbf{\ur{شرح}}, \emph{sharah}.) To bring out? (\textbf{\ur{ابھارنا}}, \emph{ubhārnā}.) A study? (\textbf{\ur{مطالعہ}}, \emph{mutāliā}.) According to? (\textbf{\ur{مطابق}}, \emph{mutābiq}.) A sample? (\textbf{\ur{نمونہ}}, \emph{namūnā}.) To compare? (\textbf{\ur{موازنہ} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{muvāzanā karnā}.) To assess? (\textbf{\ur{پرکھنا}}, \emph{parakhnā}.) An article? (\textbf{\ur{مضمون}}, \emph{mazmūn}.) A thesis? (\textbf{\ur{مقالہ}}, \emph{maqālā}.) An intellectual? (\textbf{\ur{دانشور}}, \emph{dānishvar}.) Knowledge? (\textbf{\ur{علم}}, \emph{ilm}.) To pick out? (\textbf{\ur{چھانٹنا}}, \emph{chhānṭnā}.) A theory? (\textbf{\ur{نظریہ}}, \emph{nazariyā}.) An exception? (\textbf{\ur{استثنا}}, \emph{istisnā}.) Real? (\textbf{\ur{حقیقی}}, \emph{haqīqī}.) To hold up? (\textbf{\ur{ٹکنا}}, \emph{ṭiknā}.) To win acceptance for? (\textbf{\ur{منوانا}}, \emph{manvānā}.) Reasonable? (\textbf{\ur{معقول}}, \emph{māqūl}.) Due? (\textbf{\ur{واجب}}, \emph{vājib}.) Legitimate? (\textbf{\ur{جائز}}, \emph{jāiz}.) A groundless fear? (\textbf{\ur{وہم}}, \emph{vahm}.) Unwarranted? (\textbf{\ur{بے} \ur{جا}}, \emph{be-jā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
